note: The sha256 is the byte hash ON THE REFERENCE PLATFORM ONLY. The summary's computed columns run through exp(), which is the platform libm and numpy's per-architecture SIMD kernels, and neither is required by IEEE 754 to be correctly rounded. Other platforms reproduce the VALUES to within a few ULP, not the bytes. The six reference tables carry no transcendental arithmetic and ARE byte-portable; that is checked on every CI platform.
